public_domain_references.asv: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
public_domain_references.kjv: And in all the land were no women found [so] fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
public_domain_references.brenton: And there were not found in comparison with the daughters of Job, fairer [women] than they in all the world: and their father gave them an inheritance among their brethren.

pob.text: After this[a], Job lived one hundred and forty years, and saw his sons and his grandsons, four generations.

spob.text: After this, Job lived another 140 years. He lived to see his sons and grandsons through four generations.

public_domain_references.bsb: After this, Job lived 140 years and saw his children and their children to the fourth generation.
public_domain_references.web: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
public_domain_references.asv: And after this Job lived a hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, [even] four generations.
public_domain_references.kjv: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, [even] four generations.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Job lived after [his] affliction a hundred and seventy years: and all the years he lived were two hundred and forty: and Job saw his sons and his sons' sons, the fourth generation.

pob.text: And Job died[a], old and full of days.

spob.text: Job died when he was old, after living a full span of days.

public_domain_references.bsb: And so Job died, old and full of years.
public_domain_references.web: So Job died, being old and full of days.
public_domain_references.asv: So Job died, being old and full of days.
public_domain_references.kjv: So Job died, [being] old and full of days.
public_domain_references.brenton: And Job died, an old man and full of days:
